color.summary: Warm greys on white: ink #2d2c2b, quieter text #44423f and #63605d, borders #e2ded9, and #f9f4f2 under chips, secondary buttons and tinted cards. The marketing pages keep an older body ink, #4b4c4d. Blue #0061ef (hover #0040ea) is the primary and the link color. The logo's orange #ff7300 and sunny yellows (#ffce00, #ffb700) fill illustrations and promo sections. The app's dark theme is navy: #050726 page, #101340 surfaces, #2a2d55 borders, #e5e7ec ink.

type.summary: One proprietary family, Headspace Apercu (DM Sans is the closest free match). Buttons are bold and tracked -0.03em: 16px in the app, 18px on marketing chips and calls to action. Body copy is 16px. Headings are bold, at -0.03em in the app (56, 48, 32, 24 and 20px) and -0.04em on marketing pages.

shape.summary: Pills for buttons, chips, badges and the segmented control. Fields, selects and popups have 12px corners, dialogs and drawers 24px, checkboxes 4px. Marketing cards vary: 8, 12, 24 and 32px.

spacing.summary: Buttons step xSmall 24px, small 32px (16px sides), medium 40px, mLarge 48px (24px sides) and large 56px. Fields and select triggers are 56px with the label inside. Marketing sections space mostly at 24 and 32px.

elevation.summary: Depth is a 2px unblurred lip, 0 2px 0 at 20% (#14131333), under primary buttons, switch knobs, slider thumbs and marketing cards; pressing a button removes it. Popups take 0 0 12px at 20%; the marketing header's menu sits on 0 5px 10px at 7%. Dialog backdrops are 50% black with no blur. Focus is a 2px #0040ea ring.

button.summary: Bold pills. On marketing pages the main action is blue #0061ef or ink #2d2c2b on the 2px lip, and the secondary is a #f9f4f2 pill. Topic chips (Popular, Featured) are #f9f4f2 pills that turn ink when chosen. Hover darkens a fill; pressing drops the lip. In the app the same pills come as primary, secondary and ghost at mLarge (48px, 24px sides, 16px text), disabled at 40% opacity.
